question: Under India's Anaemia Mukt Bharat (AMB) programme, weekly iron and folic acid supplementation (WIFS) is provided to adolescent girls and boys (10–19 years) as a preventive strategy for nutritional anaemia.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Anaemia Mukt Bharat (2018) targets 6 groups: children 6–59 months, 5–9 years, adolescents 10–19 years (WIFS), pregnant/lactating women (daily IFA), and women of reproductive age. Adolescent WIFS = weekly 60 mg iron + 400 µg folate, NOT daily.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. AMB targets 6 beneficiary groups including adolescents (10–19 years). WIFS provides 60 mg elemental iron + 400 µg folic acid weekly. This is distinct from the daily supplementation recommended for pregnant women (IFA tablets from ANC registration).
